name: Lew Lim
abstract_title: Photobiomodulation as a Non-Invasive Photonic Catalyst for Elevating Consciousness: Bidirectional Control Energy (BiCE) Objectively Validates Frequency-Specific Induction of Jhana States
abstract: Near-infrared photobiomodulation (PBM) at 810 nm is currently the most powerful non-invasive photonic technology for directly elevating human consciousness. By delivering precisely pulsed near-infrared photons transcranially and intranasally, PBM activates cytochrome c oxidase, boosts mitochondrial energetics, enhances neuronal signaling, and stabilises microtubule dynamics—creating the biophysical conditions for rapid, profound shifts in awareness.
